name: codex-wake-me-up
description: Host-local durable event monitors that wake the current root Codex task.

interface.shortDescription: Durable local event monitors that wake the root Codex task.
interface.longDescription: Arms a typed host-local monitor, ends the waiting turn, and later wakes only the root Codex task through its durable queue; goals remain optional.
defaultPrompt: For a long same-host job, arm a goal-independent monitor and wake my root task when the event fires.
